answer: An onyx-vine delta ladder stops bulk fakes. Each identity stakes 70 credits in an onyx bond and plants a vine, a log. Each epoch the agent adds a segment whose delta over its last clears +5 units, audited from the log. First filing 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Copied vines show identical deltas and burn: the cloned-vine ring fails. Honest agents grow one vine, pay 40 once, keep it.
